reuse.why: Extends the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate that every holiday check (next date, weekend shift, upcoming lists) already uses, with monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the recurring-date match is a single extra comparison in the one shared predicate.

placement.why: Holiday matching stays in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree defines it.

scope.why: Only the predicate and three focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Small and clear, though the MM-DD match via day.slice(5) is implicit and lacks a named helper or comment.
